<html lang="en-us"><head>
    <script id="tv-collections">
(function () {
  let mod = adobeopt.module("target-597238", {
    initContent: function () {
      let { modname } = mod;

      // Check for Target Recs
      if (!mod.data) {
        mod.diag("No target reco object created");
        return;
      }
      // Because there are two recommendation carousels on the page,
      // we must create a new div and use optionsOverride to point to it
      mod.carouselPlaceholderId = "aopt-rcmd-" + modname;
      const newDiv = document.createElement("div");
      newDiv.id = mod.carouselPlaceholderId;
      const bottomContent = document.querySelector(".bottom-content");
      
      const carouselContainer = document.createElement("div");
      carouselContainer.classList.add("col-xs-12");
      carouselContainer.id = "Target-Tv-Collections";
      carouselContainer.style.marginBottom = "10px";
      carouselContainer.style.borderBottom = "1px solid #ddd";
      carouselContainer.appendChild(newDiv);
      bottomContent.insertBefore(carouselContainer, bottomContent.firstChild);

      // Overrides instruct merkle.displayResults where to place carousel
      mod.data.options = {
        placementId: "aopt-rcmd-" + mod.modname,
        title: "Explore more items in this series",
        minDesktop: 1,
        showReviews: false,
        showPricePromo: true,
      };
    },
  });
})();
